official_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), U.S. Department of Commerce
retrieval_note: Fetched the official NIST publication PDF directly via HTTP GET (curl), extracted text with pypdf (no OCR, no LLM), then located each targeted subcategory's verbatim text in Table 1-4 (AI RMF Core, Appendix format) by exact subcategory-ID search. Only the 9 subcategories actually crosswalked against existing EU AI Act / GDPR requirements were ingested -- not the full 72-subcategory framework -- proportional to what Phase N's crosswalk table needs, the same way GDPR ingestion was scoped to 2 of ~99 articles rather than the whole regulation.
public_domain_note: Published by a U.S. federal government agency; not subject to copyright in the United States (17 U.S.C. §105). Distinct from ISO 27001/42001 and SOC 2's AICPA criteria, which are copyrighted/paywalled and were explicitly excluded from this project's multi-framework scope (see ROADMAP.md).
